title: 2026 NFL Draft Day Two Recap: 49ers select De'Zhaun Stribling, Browns stop Denzel Boston's slide

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 2026 NFL Draft Day Two Recap: 49ers select De'Zhaun Stribling, Browns stop Denzel Boston's slide
sources.description: The 49ers made a surprising move to draft Ole Miss WR De'Zhaun Stribling at the top of the second round. Cleveland stopped the slide of Washington receiver Denzel Boston.
